title: Double-deck stairs with the relaxed depth
why: On a double deck train 275 mm meets the permitted 270 mm, though not the general 280 mm.

spec.name: Double-deck stairs with the relaxed depth

stairs.step_height_mm.rationale: 4.2.2.8(1): 'maximum height of 200 mm and a minimum depth of 280 mm ... For double deck trains it is permitted to reduce this value to 270 mm': the relaxation is for the depth only; 210 > 200.

stairs.step_depth_mm.rationale: 4.2.2.8(1): 'maximum height of 200 mm and a minimum depth of 280 mm ... For double deck trains it is permitted to reduce this value to 270 mm': double deck, so 270 mm is permitted; 275 ≥ 270.
